events.title: Sunshine Coast National Art Prize 2026 Finalists Exhibition
events.datetime: 21 Aug – 11 Oct 2026, gallery open regular hours
events.location: Caloundra Regional Gallery, Felicity House, Caloundra
events.description: A high-profile exhibition showcasing the finalists of the prestigious National Art Prize, featuring diverse contemporary works from artists across Australia. It serves as a great space for quiet contemplation and observing current trends in the visual arts.
